subject.title: [Bug]: plugin temp-dir tests fail on any host where /tmp/openclaw is preferable (env-coupled os.tmpdir assertions)

question: Should this protected maintainer-labeled plugin test reliability issue be repaired now, and should the repair stay test-only?
rationale: The bug shape is narrow and source-supported, but the protected label explicitly pauses cleanup and automated repair until a maintainer owns the next step.

options.title: Approve narrow test repair
options.body: Update only the affected tests to assert or inject the resolver contract so they pass on hosts where `/tmp/openclaw` is preferred.

options.title: Keep as maintainer-tracked cleanup
options.body: Leave the issue open without automation if maintainers want to batch it with other temp-helper test cleanup.

options.title: Broaden into temp-helper audit
options.body: Use this as a maintainer-led audit of raw `/tmp` and `os.tmpdir()` assumptions across plugin tests before changing code.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow test repair
recommendation.body: Update only the affected tests to assert or inject the resolver contract so they pass on hosts where `/tmp/openclaw` is preferred.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the linked git-staging PR and authored its final fixup, making him the strongest recent routing owner for the affected test surface.
